headlines.title: Paramount reaches deal with states over $110B Warner Bros. merger
headlines.description: Paramount Skydance's $110 billion merger with Warner Bros. Discovery is now set to move ahead as the company settled with a group of state attorneys general. NBC News' Allie Canal reports more on the latest details and the future of the film industry.

headlines.title: News networks refuse to provide pool coverage of White House after CNN was banned
headlines.description: Television news networks are now refusing to provide pool coverage of President Trump's activities at the White House after the administration banned CNN, MS NOW and Politico. NBC News' Garrett Haake has details on the latest developments between the president and the media.

headlines.title: FAA orders ground stops at Newark, Philadelphia and Teterboro airports
headlines.description: The Federal Aviation Administration ordered ground stops at Newark Liberty International Airport, New Jersey's Teterboro Airport and Philadelphia International Airport because of an equipment outage, officials say. NBC News' Tom Costello shares the latest details.

headlines.title: Tech stocks power market surge as bond yields and oil prices tumble
headlines.description: Tech stocks surged Monday, with the Nasdaq 100 recording its single best day since early August as a wave of euphoria swept over the markets.

headlines.title: Elon Musk is flying under the radar in the Texas Senate race. Republicans like it that way.
headlines.description: The last time Elon Musk sank money into an election, he played a starring role in the 2025 state Supreme Court race in Wisconsin.

headlines.title: CDC’s teen behavior report focuses on nutrition, downplays sex and drug use
headlines.description: The new CDC report on teen health focused on high schoolers playing sports and making healthier food choices, priorities for Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.

headlines.title: Presley Gerber, Model and Son of Cindy Crawford, Dies at 27
headlines.description: Hollywood is mourning the loss of Presley Gerber, the son of supermodel Cindy Crawford and businessman Rande Gerber. The 27-year-old died Sunday at a rehab facility, according to the LA County medical examiner. Gerber, who had followed in his famous mother’s footsteps working as a model since he was a teenager, was also very open in recent years about his difficult struggles with mental health issues and substance abuse. NBC’s Liz Kreutz reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Sole Survivor: A Daughter Left Behind After the Nepal Floods
headlines.description: 7-year-old Pratima Tamang is one of hundreds of children now orphaned due to the Nepal floods. Her closest surviving relative, an uncle, found her after her home was swept away. NBC News follows this family in the aftermath of the floods as they try to put their lives back together.

headlines.title: The Chiefs and Patrick Mahomes look like their old selves, but now with new help
headlines.description: With playmakers surrounding Patrick Mahomes, and late-game moxie that helped them survive a wild overtime play, the Kansas City Chiefs improved to 2-0.

headlines.title: What might an AI doomsday look like? Experts have given it some thought
headlines.description: A small but dedicated group of AI experts has been warning for years that increasingly powerful AI systems could cause catastrophic damage or even lead to human extinction.

headlines.title: Texas college quarterback apologizes for comments about violent AI video
headlines.description: Texas Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning apologized for referencing an AI video showing his coach slapping ESPN sideline reporter Holly Rowe. “In my press conference yesterday, I made an insensitive comment about an AI video. There is nothing funny about it,” Manning wrote.

headlines.title: 2 battling fire at Yosemite killed in helicopter crash
headlines.description: Two members of a helicopter crew battling the Dome Fire in Yosemite National Park were killed in a crash on Sunday, the U.S Forest Service said.
